title: Roborock Session Area Cleaned Leaderboard
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=roborock:session area_sqm=*
| stats sum(area_sqm) as total_value, avg(area_sqm) as avg_value by room_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks room values by total and average area cleaned across Roborock session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `area_sqm` values for each Roborock session event and review total and average area cleaned by room.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total area cleaned.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which room shows the biggest area cleaned numbers in your Roborock session data.
